parts.text: A student is determining the weight of a metre rule using a balancing method. The apparatus is shown in Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • The student places the load P on the metre rule at the 5.0 cm mark. • She places the metre rule on the pivot at the 45.0 cm mark. • She places load Q on the rule and adjusts its position so that the metre rule is as near as possible to being balanced. • She measures the distance x between the centre of load P and the pivot and the distance y from the centre of load Q to the pivot. • She repeats the procedure, placing the load P at the 10.0 cm mark, at the 15.0 cm mark, at the 20.0 cm mark and at the 25.0 cm mark. The readings are shown in Table 1.1. Table 1.1 x / y / A / B / 40.0 42.5 35.0 36.0 30.0 30.0 25.0 24.0 20.0 17.5

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) • For each value of x , calculate A = Px , where P = 1.00 N. Record the values in the table. P is the weight of load P . • For each value of y , calculate B = Qy , where Q = 0.80 N. Record the values in the table. Q is the weight of load Q . [1]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the column headings in the table. [1]

ms.label: 1(a)(ii)
ms.text: cm, cm, N cm, N cm

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Plot a graph of A / N cm ( y -axis) against B / N cm ( x -axis). Start both axes at the origin (0,0). [4]

ms.label: 1(b)
ms.text:
Graph:
Axes correctly labelled with quantity, right way round
Appropriate scales, starting at origin (0,0)
All plots correct to ½ small square
Good line judgement, thin, continuous, single line through the plots; with neat plots

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Using the graph, determine the vertical intercept Y (the value of A when B = 0 N cm). Show clearly on the graph how you obtained this value. Y = ........................................................... [1]

ms.label: 1(c)
ms.text: Method shown on graph and Y correct to ½ small square.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Calculate the weight W of the metre rule using the equation W = Y z , where z = 5.0 cm. W = ........................................................... [1]

ms.label: 1(e)
ms.text: Difficulty of achieving balance or other sensible suggestion

ms.label: 1(f)
ms.text: Expect agree; allow ecf. Explanation includes idea of close enough (or, ecf, too different)
